contact.basis: Fixed southeast approach104malong native axis before independent ground. Bridge deck/arch/footing levels are architectural estimates; modern source river/water and threshold grade not surveyed.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native Alcantara native whole bridge frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.4m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Composite urban heights may include/interpolate structure and vegetation; exact building approach/urban grade classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
